description: This Java class 'FilterSpan' is a custom text span used to render filter 'chips' in a search text view, following material design guidelines. It draws a rounded background with an icon and label, representing a filter type, with visual styling including shadows and color adjustments based on background brightness.

classes.description: A custom ReplacementSpan that renders a filter chip with icon and label, styled according to material design.
